args.description: JE-00293: Consulting payment to K. Lindqvist ($4,800 USD) lacks supporting documentation. No vendor invoice, contract, or SOW found in document system. Only evidence is bank wire (BT-US-0080) dated 2026-03-25. Cannot provide proper support to auditor for this transaction.

args.text:
MEMORANDUM

TO: Ostrander CPA (Auditors)
FROM: Halvard Systems Inc. - Accounting Department
DATE: April 3, 2026
RE: Response to PBC Request #14 - March 2026 Journal Entry Sample

We have completed our review of the five sampled March 2026 journal entries requested in your PBC Request #14, dated April 2, 2026. Below is our status on each entry:

ENTRIES WITH SUPPORTING DOCUMENTATION ATTACHED:

1. JE-00237 | March 5, 2026 | $1,850.00 USD
   Pluralsight - Team training licences (10 seats)
   Account: Training & Conferences (6320)
   Support: DOC-0168 (Pluralsight invoice PL-7781)
   Status: ✓ SUPPORTED

2. JE-00298 | March 26, 2026 | $2,240.00 USD
   Pinecrest Janitorial - Office cleaning, March 2026
   Account: Facilities & Cleaning (6120)
   Support: DOC-0199 (Pinecrest Janitorial invoice PJ-0326)
   Status: ✓ SUPPORTED

3. JE-00275 | March 19, 2026 | $6,000.00 USD
   Ostrander CPA - Interim audit fieldwork, FY2026
   Account: Audit & Accounting Fees (6510)
   Support: DOC-0192 (Ostrander CPA invoice OC-2026-11)
   Status: ✓ SUPPORTED

4. JE-00288 | March 23, 2026 | $4,500.00 USD
   Talentbridge Recruiting - Placement fee for J. Moreno (Sr Engineer)
   Account: Recruiting (6030)
   Support: DOC-0198 (Talentbridge Recruiting invoice TB-4410)
   Status: ✓ SUPPORTED

ENTRY LACKING PROPER SUPPORT:

5. JE-00293 | March 25, 2026 | $4,800.00 USD
   Consulting - K. Lindqvist
   Account: Consulting Fees (6520)
   Support: NONE - NO VENDOR INVOICE OR CONTRACT FOUND
   Status: ✗ UNSUPPORTED - FLAGGED FOR CONTROLLER REVIEW

This entry, posted on March 25, 2026, is supported only by an outgoing wire bank transaction (BT-US-0080). Our search of the document system found no corresponding vendor invoice, consulting agreement, statement of work, or other supporting documentation for payment to K. Lindqvist. This entry has been flagged as Exception EXC-001 for immediate controller review and appropriate documentation procedures.

CONCLUSION:

Four of the five sampled entries (80%) have complete supporting documentation now attached in the ledger system and are available for your audit review. The fifth entry (JE-00293) lacks proper supporting documentation and has been escalated to management for resolution.

All supporting documents referenced above are available in our system and have been attached to their respective journal entries for your review.

Please contact us if you require any additional information regarding these entries.
